featured.headline: Chinese AI Firms Have Cracked The Code For Training LLMs While Dealing With U.S. Chip Tightening Measures; Using OpenAI’s Models For “Industrial-Scale Distillation”

articles.headline: Chinese AI Firms Have Cracked The Code For Training LLMs While Dealing With U.S. Chip Tightening Measures; Using OpenAI’s Models For “Industrial-Scale Distillation”

briefing.summary: Chinese artificial intelligence firms have developed alternative methods to train large language models in response to United States chip restrictions. These companies are reportedly relying on OpenAI models to carry out knowledge distillation at an industrial scale.
briefing.whyItMatters: Knowledge distillation allows machine learning teams to train capable models even when access to cutting-edge AI hardware is heavily constrained.
